limitation: gnb=gnb-0 slice=urllc: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; gnb=gnb-1 slice=urllc: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; gnb=gnb-1 slice=embb: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; gnb=gnb-2 slice=urllc: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; gnb=gnb-2 slice=embb: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; admission decisions are realized via PRB-ceiling adjustment (slicing_control_m min/max_ratio), not a literal per-flow accept at the scheduler, because real OAI's xApp control API only exposes ratio ceilings -- see action_mapping.py module docstring.; reward eq.2's '-beta*F_t' term is implemented as beta*(1-fairness_ratio) (load imbalance), not a literal subtraction of the fairness ratio itself, because the latter would penalize good load balance -- see reward.py docstring.; episode horizon and step cadence follow Stage Zero's protocol (60 steps/episode, 5s/step live; offline training targets the full 300-episode Table I schedule against a synthetic/replayed KPM feed), not a literal replay of the papers' original simulated training run.; each pending request in a step is decided independently by concatenating a one-hot slice/gNB identity onto the shared step observation (see env.encode_request_context) and reusing the same policy instance per request, rather than the papers' one-request-per-step formulation -- see Stage Zero plan.

limitation: gnb=gnb-0 slice=urllc: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; gnb=gnb-0 slice=embb: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; gnb=gnb-1 slice=urllc: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; gnb=gnb-1 slice=embb: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; gnb=gnb-2 slice=embb: dl_mac_buffer_occupation was 0 for all UEs; used (dl_errors + dl_bler) as a backlog proxy for L_k(t).; admission decisions are realized via PRB-ceiling adjustment (slicing_control_m min/max_ratio), not a literal per-flow accept at the scheduler, because real OAI's xApp control API only exposes ratio ceilings -- see action_mapping.py module docstring.; reward eq.2's '-beta*F_t' term is implemented as beta*(1-fairness_ratio) (load imbalance), not a literal subtraction of the fairness ratio itself, because the latter would penalize good load balance -- see reward.py docstring.; episode horizon and step cadence follow Stage Zero's protocol (60 steps/episode, 5s/step live; offline training targets the full 300-episode Table I schedule against a synthetic/replayed KPM feed), not a literal replay of the papers' original simulated training run.; each pending request in a step is decided independently by concatenating a one-hot slice/gNB identity onto the shared step observation (see env.encode_request_context) and reusing the same policy instance per request, rather than the papers' one-request-per-step formulation -- see Stage Zero plan.
